snippet.title: Send In The Clown - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer | IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
Join co-directors Nick and Jacques at developer Mad Herons as they discuss Send In The Clown's one-and-only turn-based RPG battle in this latest trailer for the upcoming RPG. Meet characters you can recruit, check out their abilities, and prepare for battle! Send In The Clown will be available on Steam. You can wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3766220/Send_In_The_Clown/

Send In The Clown is a bite-sized birthday catastrophe clown comedy role-playing experience – with minigames! Step into the oversized shoes of Pockets, history’s least-appreciated clown, and save twelve-year-old Miranda’s disastrous birthday party in this one-hour comedy RPG! Unlock classic clown abilities, befriend guests, and take down Tad, Miranda’s party-usurping brother!

#IGN #Gaming #FanFest
